name: Liverpool
meta_description: Liverpool brewery tours, beer tastings and guided pub crawls — from the Baltic Triangle to historic city-centre pubs. Compare top-rated experiences.
intro_md:
Liverpool's drinking culture is woven into its architecture. The Philharmonic Dining Rooms on Hope Street is often called one of the most ornate pubs in Britain — Grade I listed, all mosaic and mahogany — and the Georgian Quarter around it is full of handsome spots for a pint. Down towards the old docks, the Baltic Triangle has become the city's creative quarter, home to Cains Brewery Village, where the Victorian brewery buildings now house bars, street food and the Baltic Market food hall.

Between the two, Ropewalks packs bars and late-night venues into former warehouses, while the traditional pubs around Dale Street keep older habits alive. It's a compact, walkable city — which makes it ideal pub crawl territory.

Don't miss:

- The Philharmonic Dining Rooms' Grade I-listed interior
- Cains Brewery Village and Baltic Market
- Ropewalks for bars in converted warehouses
- The traditional pubs around Dale Street

gyg_tours.title: Liverpool: Brewery Bus Tour with 12 Beer and Pizza
gyg_tours.summary: A four-hour minibus tour visiting four Liverpool breweries, with twelve beer tastings and pizza included, guided by a local with insights into the city's brewing heritage.
gyg_tours.description_md: Join a four-hour guided minibus tour visiting four local breweries around Liverpool. Along the way you sample between eight and twelve freshly crafted beers, paired with food including pizza. The tour offers behind-the-scenes access to the breweries and insights into the city's brewing scene, guided by a beer sommelier.
highlights: Visit four local Liverpool breweries
Taste 8 to 12 freshly crafted beers
Enjoy food including pizza
Go behind the scenes at the breweries
Meet a beer sommelier
Comfortable minibus transport
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Outside the Shankly Hotel building, by the main road.

gyg_tours.title: Liverpool: Guided Pub Crawl Tour with 3 Drinks
gyg_tours.summary: A two-hour guided crawl of three of Liverpool's iconic pubs, with three half-pint drinks included and local history and culture along the way.
gyg_tours.description_md: Join a guided pub crawl through Liverpool city centre, taking in the city's highlights alongside three iconic pubs. Starting outside the Philharmonic Dining Rooms at the top of the city, you make your way down through the streets, passing famous landmarks and stopping at some of Liverpool's best-known pubs. The price includes three half-pint drinks (or soft drink equivalents), with the chance to sample local ales where available. The tour is well suited to first-time visitors and solo travellers, and finishes near the River Mersey.
highlights: Guided pub crawl through Liverpool city centre
3 half-pint drinks or soft drink equivalents included
Visit 3 iconic Liverpool pubs
See landmarks and city highlights en route
Learn local history from your guide
Ideal for first-time visitors and solo travellers
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Outside the Philharmonic Dining Rooms, at the top of the city centre

gyg_tours.title: Liverpool: Albert Dock & Cavern Quarter Walking Food Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A three-hour walking food tour through the waterfront, Liverpool ONE and the Cavern Quarter, sampling local specialities including Scouse, fish and chips, and local beer or cider.
gyg_tours.description_md: This guided walking food tour explores Liverpool through its food and drink, beginning at the iconic waterfront before weaving through Liverpool ONE and finishing in the music-filled Cavern Quarter. Over around three hours, you stop at four or more tasting locations showcasing both traditional dishes and the city's contemporary culinary scene. Tastings include a freshly baked pastry with coffee or tea, handcrafted fudge, a British sausage roll, and Liverpool's signature Scouse stew or fish and chips (with a vegetarian Blind Scouse alternative available). The tour finishes with a glass of local beer or cider, served only to those aged 18 and over.
highlights: Guided three-hour walking food tour
Stop at 4+ local tasting locations
Try Liverpool's signature Scouse stew
Taste fish and chips, fudge and sausage roll
Explore the Waterfront, Liverpool ONE and Cavern Quarter
Finish with a local beer or cider
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Old Wall Arch, Albert Dock, on Gower Street

gyg_tours.title: Liverpool: Guided Food and Drink Tour with Full Lunch
gyg_tours.summary: A three-hour guided food tour through the Georgian Quarter and Ropewalks, with five food stops at independent eateries and two paired drinks included.
gyg_tours.description_md: Join a local guide for a walking food and drink tour through Liverpool's neighbourhoods, taking in independent eateries across areas such as the Ropewalks and Georgian Quarter. The route features five food and drink stops, with tastings ranging from traditional scouse stew to contemporary Asian dishes, finishing at a dessert venue. Two of the stops include a drink, with a choice of beer, wine or cocktails and mocktails. The roughly 2 km walk is led in English and runs over about three hours.
highlights: Five food and drink tastings
Two drinks included (beer, wine or cocktails)
Traditional scouse stew and Asian cuisine
Local guide throughout
Walk through Ropewalks and Georgian Quarter
Small group, maximum 10 people
gyg_tours.meeting_point: The Bluecoat, School Lane; guides wait at the front gates beneath a large tree.

gyg_tours.title: Liverpool: Beer Bike Tour with Drinks and Music
gyg_tours.summary: An hour-long pedal-powered bike tour through Liverpool's Baltic Triangle, with drinks and music on board and a sober captain doing the steering.
gyg_tours.description_md: This is a social cycling experience through Liverpool's Baltic Triangle, where a group pedals together on a shared beer bike. A trained sober captain handles the steering and safety while riders enjoy drinks and music along the way. The ride lasts around 60 minutes and is fully pedal-powered, with room for up to 12 people.
highlights: 60-minute guided beer bike ride
Drinks included: beer or prosecco per guest
Trained sober captain steers and keeps you safe
Music on board throughout the ride
Explore Liverpool's Baltic Triangle
Group bike for up to 12 people
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Baltic Triangle area of Liverpool (exact address not stated)
